The '''T-s5 [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] [[Proton torpedo launcher/Legends|launcher]]''' was manufactured by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] for use in the [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE Bomber]], which also mounted an [[M-s3 concussion missile launcher/Legends|M-s3 concussion missile launcher]] in its ordnance pod.
